user.title: Set up Smart Plants
user.description: OpenPlantBook is optional and uses its API directly. You need an OpenPlantBook account and client credentials. [Get OpenPlantBook API credentials]({openplantbook_credentials_url}). Do not install the separate Home Assistant OpenPlantBook integration. Manual plant management works without credentials.
